comments.author: Big-Bag-7504
comments.body:
A game's fun comes from its balance, this game has no balance. Just upgrade weapons enough and 1 shot everything forever. No need for new ships, no need for other upgrades, no need to engage with 90% of your content.   
You need to set up a balanced progression.   
It's also as shallow as a puddle, there's no room anywhere for tactics of any kind or for me to feel like I've outsmarted an opponent even with progression. a 1 vs 1 ship battle with 4 moves and 4 upgrade options is literally playing a spreadsheet.  
I think it has some potential, but I think you need to ask yourself, what's fun about it?

replies.author: kasperja
replies.body: it will be slowly more and more difficult the longer you get. The early game if about focusing on building up the highest amount of scrap for the later runs. I want it to be easy in the beginning so it is for everyone (easy to learn hard to master).
